payload.name: Lugg
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Instant quotes for on-demand moving and delivery. Tell ChatGPT your pickup and drop-off, compare truck options with real prices, and book vetted professional movers in minutes. Furniture delivery, Marketplace pickups, storage moves, donation drop-offs, junk removal—Lugg handles it all. Same-day or scheduled, with upfront pricing. Over 1 million moves completed.
payload.longDescription: 为按需搬家和配送提供即时报价。告诉 ChatGPT 取件和送达地点，比较价格真实的卡车选项，并在几分钟内预订经过审核的专业搬运工。家具配送、二手平台取货、搬入仓储、捐赠物品送达、垃圾清运——Lugg 全都能处理。支持当天或预约服务，价格提前透明。已完成超过 100 万次搬运。

payload.name: Metaprona
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search live real-estate listings for sale and rent across Albania and Kosovo — apartments, houses, villas, offices and land in Tiranë, Durrës, Vlorë, Sarandë, Prishtinë and more. Filter by city, price, rooms and size, check average €/m² and rent prices by city, and open any listing directly on metaprona.com. Results come live from 17,000+ active listings on Metaprona, Albania's open property marketplace.
payload.longDescription: 搜索阿尔巴尼亚和科索沃各地的实时待售和出租房源——公寓、房屋、别墅、办公室和土地，覆盖地拉那、都拉斯、发罗拉、萨兰达、普里什蒂纳等地。按城市、价格、房间和面积筛选，查看各城市平均 €/m² 和租金，并直接在 metaprona.com 打开任意房源。结果实时来自 Metaprona（阿尔巴尼亚开放房产市场）17,000 多条活跃房源。

payload.name: HORIZON SHIELD
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HORIZON SHIELD checks whether a Japanese construction or renovation estimate is fair. Give it a work type and a quoted price, and it compares the amount against fair-price ranges curated from 30 years of on-site construction experience, flags overcharge risk, and explains unit prices. It also detects common high-pressure sales phrases. Backed by JCCDB, an open construction-cost dataset of 65,729 items across 63 categories.
payload.longDescription: HORIZON SHIELD 可检查日本的建筑或装修报价是否合理。提供工程类型和报价后，它会将金额与依据 30 年现场施工经验整理的合理价格区间进行比较，提示过度收费风险并解释单价。它还会识别常见的高压销售话术。数据由 JCCDB 提供支持，这是一个开放的建筑成本数据集，包含 63 个类别的 65,729 项数据。

payload.name: Perchli Property Search
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Perchli connects buyers with Northern Ireland estate agents. This MCP-only plugin lets ChatGPT search live Perchli listings by location, price, bedrooms, type, EPC and features; fetch full detail for a specific listing including price, tenure, EPC, rates, features, marketing agent and photos; answer average or typical price questions from the official LPS/NISRA NI House Price Index; and estimate a buyer's budget and monthly mortgage payment from income and deposit using live Bank of England rates. All tools are anonymous and read-only: no sign-in, no personal data, no bookings and no state changes. Affordability figures are illustrative only and never financial advice. Viewing requests are handed off to the Perchli app for the user to confirm.
payload.longDescription: Perchli 连接买家与北爱尔兰房地产经纪人。该 MCP 插件可按地点、价格、卧室数、类型、EPC 和设施搜索实时房源，获取具体房源的价格、产权、EPC、费率、设施、营销代理和照片；也可基于官方 LPS/NISRA 北爱尔兰房价指数回答平均或典型价格，并用收入、首付和实时英格兰银行利率估算预算及月供。所有工具匿名且只读：无需登录，不收集个人数据，不预订也不改变状态。可负担性数字仅供参考，不构成金融建议；看房请求会转交 Perchli 应用供用户确认。

payload.name: Pregnancy Wheel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn your last menstrual period date or due date into an interactive pregnancy wheel. Instantly see your current week, trimester, due date, and days remaining, along with a fun fruit-size comparison for how big your baby is right now. You can also look up any week from 1 to 42 to see what's ahead, even without a specific date.

This app is developed by an independent developer and is not a medical device or a substitute for professional medical, obstetric, or midwifery advice. Always consult your doctor, midwife, or other qualified healthcare provider regarding your pregnancy and prenatal care.

payload.name: REMAX Europe
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: REMAX Europe lets users search live REMAX property listings across 25 European countries and browse the results in an interactive, image-rich gallery without leaving the chat. Users ask in plain language, a city or country, a budget, sale or rental, residential or commercial, minimum size or rooms, elevator access, and get up to 100 matching listings with photos, prices, and key facts, sortable by price or size and viewable in any of 32 languages. Tapping a listing opens a full detail view with a photo carousel, description (with on-demand translation), agent contact, and a link to the full page on remax.eu.

payload.name: Bonfire
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create and launch custom merchandise campaigns with ease. This app helps you design apparel, explore product ideas, and set up listings for your Bonfire store. Get practical guidance on pricing, campaign setup, and improving your listings so you can reach more supporters and run successful merch campaigns.
payload.longDescription: 轻松创建并推出定制周边商品营销活动。此应用帮助你设计服装、探索产品创意，并为 Bonfire 商店设置商品页面。获取关于定价、活动设置和优化商品页面的实用指导，以触达更多支持者并成功开展周边商品营销活动。

payload.name: Share-A-Cart
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Share-A-Cart helps signed-in users list supported retailers, find products and deals, inspect carts in their cart history, and create or update shareable shopping carts from ChatGPT.

payload.name: La Dépêche du Midi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Retrouvez l’actualité de La Dépêche du Midi directement dans ChatGPT : consultez les dernières informations, explorez les articles qui vous intéressent et suivez les évènements en direct.

Une manière simple et pratique de rester informé, à tout moment, avec La Dépêche du Midi.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中直接查看 La Dépêche du Midi 的新闻：浏览最新资讯、查找感兴趣的文章，并实时关注重大事件。

通过 La Dépêche du Midi，随时随地轻松便捷地了解新闻。

payload.name: Tessun Immobilien
payload.description: 慕尼黑及伊萨尔-洛伊萨赫谷房产
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Tessun Immobilien app makes property searching in Munich and the Isar-Loisach Valley clearer and more locally focused.

Instead of browsing through long property lists, users can see available properties directly on an interactive map. This makes it easier to quickly understand which location best fits their daily life — whether in Munich, Wolfratshausen, Geretsried, or the surrounding areas.

Faster geographic orientation
Users can immediately see where a property is located and what the surrounding area looks like.

Better understanding of the location
Especially in regions like Munich or the Isar-Loisach Valley, the micro-location is often crucial. The map view helps users better evaluate distances, infrastructure, and the surrounding environment realistically.

Focus on relevant regional properties
Instead of thousands of random listings, the app focuses on selected properties from a regionally specialized real estate agency.

Easier comparison of different locations
Users can directly recognize how residential areas differ — for example, between urban Munich and quieter surrounding towns.

Less time wasted on unsuitable listings
Many users choose based on location first. The visual search makes this step much faster.

Direct contact with a local expert
Interested users can easily send inquiries or arrange viewings without having to switch between multiple platforms.

More enjoyable mobile experience
The search feels more intuitive because users can browse the map and actively explore different regions.

The app is designed not to make property searching more complicated, but more understandable — with a clear focus on location, regional expertise, and easier navigation through the real estate market around Munich and the Isar-Loisach Valley.
payload.longDescription:
Tessun Immobilien 应用让慕尼黑和伊萨尔-洛伊萨赫谷的房产搜索更清晰，也更聚焦本地。

用户无需浏览冗长房源列表，即可在交互式地图上查看可售房产。这有助于快速了解哪个地点最适合日常生活，无论是在慕尼黑、沃尔夫拉茨豪森、格雷茨里德还是周边地区。

更快了解地理位置
用户可以立即查看房产所在位置及周边环境。

更好地了解地点
尤其在慕尼黑或伊萨尔-洛伊萨赫谷等地区，微观地段往往至关重要。地图视图有助于用户切实评估距离、基础设施和周边环境。

聚焦相关地区房产
应用不提供数千条随机房源，而是聚焦于一家专注特定地区的房地产中介精选房产。

更轻松地比较不同地点
用户可以直接看出不同居住区域的差异，例如城市化的慕尼黑与更安静的周边城镇。

减少在不合适房源上浪费的时间
许多用户会先根据地点筛选。可视化搜索让这一步快得多。

直接联系本地专家
感兴趣的用户可以轻松发送咨询或安排看房，无需在多个平台之间切换。

更愉快的移动端体验
用户可以浏览地图并主动探索不同地区，搜索过程因而更直观。

此应用旨在让房产搜索更易理解，而非更复杂，重点关注地点、地区专业知识，以及更轻松地浏览慕尼黑和伊萨尔-洛伊萨赫谷周边房地产市场。

payload.name: Lissiland
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lottery Winning Numbers helps you look up draw results for major multistate games. Ask for the latest Powerball, Mega Millions, or other supported games and see a visual winning-numbers card with main balls, bonus balls, and jackpot lines. You can also check typed picks or scan a ticket photo against the latest draw. Data is synced from lottery operator feeds; results are informational only and not official lottery validation. Operated by Lissiland LLC.
payload.longDescription: Lottery Winning Numbers 帮助你查询多个州联合彩票的开奖结果。询问最新一期 Powerball、Mega Millions 或其他支持的彩票，即可查看包含主号码、特别号码和头奖信息的可视化中奖号码卡片。你也可以输入选号或扫描彩票照片，与最新一期开奖结果进行核对。数据同步自彩票运营方的信息源；结果仅供参考，不能作为官方彩票验证。由 Lissiland LLC 运营。

payload.name: Veto Pro Pac
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: VetoProPac helps you find the right tool bag, backpack, pouch, or storage for your trade and job. Search the catalog, compare products side‑by‑side, view key specs, and send items to your cart on VetoProPac.com for checkout.

payload.name: RideLogger
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RideLogger helps users manage their private vehicle logbook through ChatGPT. Users can view and update vehicles, track fuel, charging, service, and expense records, manage maintenance reminders, and store vehicle images, documents, and log attachments in their authenticated RideLogger account.

payload.name: BoardWise
payload.description: 协助处理监管委员会事务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: BoardWise helps licensed professionals respond to actions from their regulatory boards.
payload.longDescription: BoardWise帮助持证专业人士应对其监管委员会采取的措施。

payload.name: Justlife
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect to Justlife on ChatGPT to search and explore professional home services in minutes. Describe what you need, and discover personalized options for Cleaning, Maintenance, Salon & Spa services by trained professionals near you. Review service details, pricing, and availability, then complete your booking seamlessly on the Justlife platform.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中连接 Justlife，只需几分钟即可搜索和浏览专业家庭服务。描述你的需求，发现附近训练有素的专业人员提供的个性化清洁、维修、美容院和水疗服务。查看服务详情、价格和可预约时间，然后在 Justlife 平台上顺畅完成预订。

payload.name: Paloma
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Paloma helps you find and book venues for private parties, events, and large group dining. Share your event details such as guest count, date, budget, and preferences, and Paloma connects you with venues that match based on real availability, amenities, and capabilities. From birthday parties and corporate gatherings to private dining rooms and large group tables at restaurants, Paloma makes it easy to discover suitable spaces and move from search to inquiry with confidence.
payload.longDescription: Paloma 帮助你为私人派对、活动和大型团体用餐查找并预订场地。提供宾客人数、日期、预算和偏好等活动详情后，Paloma 会根据实时空闲情况、设施和承办能力为你匹配场地。从生日派对和公司聚会，到私人包间和餐厅大桌，Paloma 让你轻松发现合适场地，并放心地从搜索进入咨询。

payload.name: Dispatcher.City
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Dispatcher.City searches the live public Berlin property map for homes to buy or rent, WG rooms, new builds, and commercial listings. It returns canonical source links together with exact snapshot counts and explicit coverage and confirmation limits. The public plugin is read-only and cannot access accounts, save searches, enable alerts, contact brokers, or make decisions.
payload.longDescription: Dispatcher.City 会搜索柏林实时公开房产地图，涵盖待售或出租房屋、合租房间、新建房屋和商业房源。它会提供规范来源链接，以及准确的快照计数和明确的覆盖范围与确认限制。公开版插件为只读，无法访问账户、保存搜索、启用提醒、联系经纪人或代替用户作出决定。

payload.name: Propusher
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Propusher is a coaching platform for building workouts and delivering them to clients through a synchronized mobile app. This app lets a coach browse their Propusher exercise library, author exercises with 3D skeletal animations, and assemble workouts, questionnaires and multi-week programs in their own account. Everything created here appears immediately in the Propusher web dashboard and in the client's mobile app. Access is scoped to the signed-in coach's account through OAuth; the app reads and writes only that coach's exercises, workouts, questionnaires and programs, and never deletes them.

payload.name: ShotPulled
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Dial in better espresso, one informed adjustment at a time.
Set up your beans, grinder, espresso machine, and scale once. After each shot, log the dose, yield, brew time, and how it tasted. ShotPulled considers the full context—including the coffee’s age and the way your grinder is calibrated—then recommends the single most useful adjustment for your next shot and explains why.
ShotPulled also keeps your coffee inventory accurate automatically. Every logged dose is deducted from the bag, so you can see the grams remaining and an estimate of how many shots are left based on the dose you actually use. It tracks the bag’s peak window too, showing how many peak days remain and the date that window ends.
When a recipe works, lock it in and return to it anytime. ShotPulled supports grinder settings across clicks, numbered collars, compound ring positions such as 1.2.2, and named settings, with built-in specifications for 67 grinders, 124 espresso machines, and 24 scales.
Your ShotPulled account stays in sync across ChatGPT, the web dashboard, and the iPhone app. Register a bag here, and it’s already waiting on your phone when you’re ready to pull your next shot.

payload.name: Petco
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Petco Shopping Assistant helps pet parents discover, select, and add pet essentials to their cart using natural language. The assistant recommends products, supports new pet adoption preparation, and guides customers toward appropriate food, toys, grooming supplies, non-prescription health and wellness supplies, and other pet products available at Petco. Payment, final checkout, and order completion happen outside ChatGPT on Petco's external checkout experience.
payload.longDescription:
该插件购物助手。以下功能和限制适用：
Petco Shopping Assistant helps pet parents discover, select, and add pet essentials to their cart using natural language. The assistant recommends products, supports new pet adoption preparation, and guides customers toward appropriate food, toys, grooming supplies, non-prescription health and wellness supplies, and other pet products available at Petco. Payment, final checkout, and order completion happen outside ChatGPT on Petco's external checkout experience.

payload.name: Secondhand Marketplace
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search Facebook Marketplace, eBay, Depop, and Poshmark all without leaving ChatGPT. Search in plain language:  "a mid-century dresser under $250 near Denver" or "Lululemon Align leggings, size 6, under $60 near me"  and get real listings with prices, photos, seller details, and links. 

Filter by price, condition, brand, size, color and more. Have chat perform specific filters on analyzing photos for condition, or getting the right shade of brown that would take ages to do yourself on a manual marketplace search. Get local results, or items to ship. Every listing's full photo set is available so you can judge condition right in the conversation.  Free to start, no setup required.
payload.longDescription:
无需离开 ChatGPT，即可搜索 Facebook Marketplace、eBay、Depop 和 Poshmark。用自然语言搜索，例如：“丹佛附近 $250 以下的世纪中期梳妆柜”或“我附近 $60 以下、6 码的 Lululemon Align 紧身裤”，即可获取真实商品列表及价格、照片、卖家详情和链接。

按价格、成色、品牌、尺码、颜色等条件筛选。你可以让聊天根据照片分析成色，或找出合适的棕色色调；若手动在交易平台搜索，这些筛选可能要花很久。获取本地结果或可邮寄的商品。每个商品列表都提供完整照片集，方便你直接在对话中判断成色。免费开始使用，无需设置。

payload.name: StyleCliq Salon Booking
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: StyleCliq Salon Booking helps customers discover published salons, compare bookable services and availability, create pay-at-salon appointments, and manage their own bookings through ChatGPT.

payload.name: Matriz del Destino
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Calcula una Matriz del Destino a partir de una fecha de nacimiento y una matriz de compatibilidad para dos personas. Devuelve energías principales, talentos, aspectos financieros y relacionales, y propósitos compartidos como herramienta espiritual y de reflexión.
payload.longDescription: 根据出生日期计算命运矩阵，并为两个人计算兼容性矩阵。作为精神探索和自我反思的工具，返回主要能量、天赋、财务和关系层面，以及共同目标。

payload.name: Farmooly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search Farmooly's live marketplace and public local-food directory for nearby producers, available products, vendor inventory, fulfillment options, SNAP/EBT signals, and farmers market schedules. Results link back to Farmooly for current details and any next steps.
payload.longDescription: 搜索 Farmooly 实时市场和本地食品目录，查找附近生产者、产品、库存、履约方式、SNAP/EBT 信号及农贸市场时间；结果链接回 Farmooly 查看最新详情。

payload.name: Comparis
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Comparis helps you find suitable apartments and houses in Switzerland.

By connecting Comparis with ChatGPT, you’ll get access to one of the largest selection of property listings across Switzerland. Get all the key information about a property at a glance, including photos, property descriptions,  all combined with ChatGPT’s conversational capabilities.

Try asking by voice or text, things like:
- Show me a 4-room apartment with a balcony and a kitchen isle in Zurich for under CHF 4,000 per month 
- Find me a modern house to buy in Basel with white bathrooms
- Are there any apartments with a lake view and parking space in Lausanne?

You can refine your search at any time by telling ChatGPT more about your preferences and requirements. Try it now and connect Comparis with ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
Comparis 帮助你在瑞士寻找合适的公寓和房屋。

将 Comparis 连接到 ChatGPT 后，你就能访问瑞士规模最大的房源信息库之一。通过 ChatGPT 的对话能力，一目了然地获取房产的所有关键信息，包括照片和房产描述。

试着用语音或文字提出这类问题：
- 帮我在苏黎世找一套每月低于 CHF 4,000、有阳台和中岛式厨房的 4 室公寓 
- 帮我在巴塞尔找一栋待售的现代住宅，浴室采用白色装修
- 洛桑有没有湖景并带停车位的公寓？

你可以随时告诉 ChatGPT 更多偏好和要求，以调整搜索条件。现在就试试将 Comparis 连接到 ChatGPT。

payload.name: newday
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: newday

payload.name: Spotts for ChatGPT
payload.description: 한국의 공개 행사와 축제 정보를 찾아봅니다.
payload.summaryOriginal: 한국의 공개 행사와 축제 정보를 찾아봅니다.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Spotts에서 한국의 공개 행사와 축제 정보를 검색하고 행사 일정·지역·종류·공개된 출연자 정보를 확인합니다. 읽기 전용으로 동작하며 사용자 계정 데이터나 예약·결제를 처리하지 않습니다.

payload.name: LiveSpot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LiveSpot is an independent Swedish event guide. Ask in plain language - "what's on in Gothenburg this weekend", "concerts in Stockholm under 500 SEK" - and get current events with venue, date, price and a direct link to book. Search by free text, city, category, date range or budget; open full event details with description, venue, availability and ticket links; browse by city or category; and find similar events to one you like. Covers concerts, theatre, musicals, dance, comedy, sport, festivals and family events across Sweden, collected daily from 13 ticketing providers. Free and read-only: no account, no API key.
payload.longDescription: LiveSpot 是独立的瑞典活动指南。用自然语言提问——“本周末哥德堡有什么活动？”“斯德哥尔摩 500 SEK 以下的音乐会”——即可获得带场馆、日期、价格和直接购票链接的当前活动。可按自由文本、城市、类别、日期范围或预算搜索；打开包含描述、场馆、可用性和票务链接的完整活动详情；按城市或类别浏览；查找与你喜欢的活动相似的活动。覆盖瑞典各地的音乐会、戏剧、音乐剧、舞蹈、喜剧、体育、节庆和家庭活动，每天从 13 家票务提供商收集信息。免费且只读：无需账户或 API 密钥。

payload.name: AjmerAstro
payload.description: 印度历法、出生星盘及KP星盘
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask in plain language — "today's panchang for Delhi", "my kundali for 18 June 1984, 3:55 PM, Ajmer, Rajasthan", "the KP chart for those details" — and get the computed values back.

Panchang and muhurat. Tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana and vara for any date and
place, with the rahukaal, yamaganda and gulika windows, the abhijit muhurat and
the full choghadiya — the things people actually check before fixing a time to
begin something.

Janam kundali. Ascendant, planetary positions with nakshatra and pada, the D1
and D9 charts, the current mahadasha and antardasha, and whether Manglik dosha
is present.

KP charts. Cuspal positions with sign lord, star lord and sub lord, plus the
planetary significators.

Birth place lookup. Returns matching cities with their timezone, so an ambiguous
name can be confirmed before a chart is drawn. Timezones are worked out for the
exact date — a July birth in London uses BST, not GMT.

No account and no sign-up. Results are astronomical calculations and traditional
Vedic classifications — not predictions, and not medical, legal or financial
advice.
payload.longDescription:
用日常语言提问——“德里今天的panchang”“我的出生星盘，1984年6月18日，下午3:55，拉贾斯坦邦阿杰梅尔”“这些信息对应的KP星盘”——即可获取计算结果。

Panchang历法与muhurat吉时。查询任意日期和
地点的tithi、nakshatra、yoga、karana和vara，以及rahukaal、yamaganda和gulika时段、abhijit muhurat
和完整choghadiya——这些都是人们在确定

payload.name: Guanyin Oracle · 观音灵签
payload.description: 以中文为主的灵签仪式
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Guanyin Oracle offers a quiet, Chinese-first reflection ritual based on a bundled 100-sign Guanyin corpus. Hold one focused question, make one symbolic draw, then confirm it with one symbolic cup action. The source sign poem and traditional note remain in Chinese, with a detailed interpretation in Chinese and faithful English.

Each reading connects the sign to the question, distinguishes reflection from prediction, and offers practical seven-day actions and clear boundaries for health, financial, legal, and other consequential topics. Users may optionally save a JPEG card for the exact sign they drew. The service processes only inputs needed to return the reading and does not persist ritual sessions.
payload.longDescription:
Guanyin Oracle 提供宁静的中文优先反思仪式，基于内置的观音 100 签内容。专注于一个问题，象征性地抽取一签，再以一次象征性的掷杯动作确认。原始签诗和传统注解保留中文，并提供详细的中文解读及忠实的英文译文。

每次解读都会结合问题说明签意，区分反思与预测，并针对健康、财务、法律及其他重大议题提供切实可行的七日行动建议和明确边界。用户还可选择为抽中的确切签号保存 JPEG 签卡。服务仅处理生成解读所需的输入，不会保存仪式会话。

payload.name: xmplaylist
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explore SiriusXM airplay tracked by xmplaylist. Find where a song played, discover new station additions, see a station’s most-played tracks, and compare changes in support for songs and artists. Read a briefing for your saved artist roster, then explore an individual artist’s songs, stations, and trends.

Results link back to xmplaylist reports and explain the selected time period and available coverage. With an explicit request, prepare a CSV export and receive its download link by email. You can also check your latest export’s status from chat.

Requires an xmplaylist account with API access. Requests share your plan’s daily API allowance. Recorded airplay may be incomplete; first detection is not a song’s release date. xmplaylist is not an official SiriusXM product.

payload.name: Autotrader
payload.summaryOriginal: Search for new and used cars
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find your new car with Autotrader, the UK’s biggest, most trusted car marketplace. Join the 9.5 million people who visit us every month to search through over 400,000 cars from 12,000 dealers nationwide. 

Use our super smart search filters to find your ideal car fast, based on make, model, mileage and more. With so many cars in one place, it’s easy to see why over 21 million people have already downloaded our #1 car buying app*. 

If it’s time for a new car, maybe it’s time for Autotrader.

使用我们极其智能的搜索筛选器，根据品牌、车型、里程等快速找到理想汽车。如此多的汽车集中在一处，不难理解为什么已有超过21百万名用户下载我们排名#1的购车应用*。

如果到了换新车的时候，也许就是使用Autotrader的时候。

payload.name: The Astro Scope Birth Arcana
payload.description: 塔罗出生牌与爱情配对
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find your Birth Arcana, the Major Arcana tarot card of your birth date, and see how your card meets someone else's.

Enter a birth date to reveal the card that stays with you for life. Add a partner's, a friend's or a family member's date to see what your two cards bring out in each other.

What you get
• Your birth card from the 22 Major Arcana, shown as a floating card that turns over, with what it means for the people born under it
• What your card says about love, career and money, with advice, each linked to the full text on theastroscope.com
• The life purpose, strengths, growth points and shadow of your card
• The best matches of your card, each opening the page of that pair
• Birth Arcana compatibility for two dates: both cards, a pair score, how your elements meet, what the pair is strong at together and where it grows
• A compact card in the chat that expands to full screen with every detail
• English and Spanish

Come back for
• A new pair reading every time you compare your card with someone new

Try asking
• "What is my tarot birth card? Born June 18, 1994"
• "Birth Arcana compatibility: June 18, 1994 and March 3, 1992"
• "What life purpose does my Birth Arcana show? Born June 18, 1994"

Your data
Only birth dates, and optionally names, are used to find the cards. Nothing is saved.

For entertainment and self-reflection, not medical, legal or financial advice.
payload.longDescription:
找到你的出生阿尔卡那牌——与你出生日期对应的大阿尔卡那塔罗牌——并了解你的牌与他人的牌如何相遇。

输入出生日期，揭示将伴随你一生的牌。再输入伴侣、朋友或家人的出生日期，看看你们的两张牌会彼此激发什么。

你将获得
• 从 22 张大阿尔卡那牌中找到你的出生牌，以翻转的浮动卡牌呈现，并说明此牌对出生于其对应日期的人意味着什么
• 了解你的牌对爱情、事业和金钱的启示及建议，每项均链接至 theastroscope.com 上的完整文章
• 了解此牌代表的人生目标、优势、成长方向和阴影面
• 查看与你的牌最相配的牌，每个配对都会打开对应页面
• 两个日期的出生阿尔卡那兼容性：双方的牌、配对评分、双方元素如何相遇、组合的优势与成长方向
• 聊天中的精简卡片，可展开至全屏查看所有详情
• 英语和西班牙语

欢迎再次使用
• 每次与你的新对象比较牌面，都会获得新的配对解读

试着这样提问
• “我的塔罗出生牌是什么？出生于 1994 年 6 月 18 日”
• “出生阿尔卡那兼容性：1994 年 6 月 18 日和 1992 年 3 月 3 日”
• “我的出生阿尔卡那显示了什么人生目标？出生于 1994 年 6 月 18 日”

你的数据
仅使用出生日期（姓名可选）来查找牌面，不会保存任何内容。

仅供娱乐和自我反思，不构成医疗、法律或财务建议。

payload.name: Slide15
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Slide15 is a sliding-tile puzzle you can play without leaving ChatGPT. Ask for a puzzle and a board appears in the conversation: swipe, tap or use the arrow keys to slide the numbered tiles until they read in order. Every puzzle is shuffled with legal moves, so it can always be solved. New boards on demand, a timer and move counter, a short how-to-play primer for first-time players, and full localisation in English, Russian and Spanish. No account is needed and nothing is collected beyond anonymous usage analytics. The same game is free on the web at slide15.com and on iPhone and iPad.

payload.name: Tirada de Cartas
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Haz tiradas interactivas de Tarot y Baraja Española directamente en ChatGPT. Elige entre 22 Arcanos Mayores, el mazo completo de 78 cartas o la Baraja Española de 40 cartas. Mezcla, corta y revela tiradas de tres cartas o en cruz de cinco posiciones, y recibe una interpretación que relaciona las cartas, sus posiciones y orientaciones con tu pregunta. Las lecturas son simbólicas y están destinadas a la reflexión y el entretenimiento.

payload.name: Triad Astro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Triad Astro reads your birth chart in three astrological traditions at once - Western (Tropical), Vedic (Sidereal), and Chinese (BaZi / Four Pillars) - and shows you where they agree.

Give it a birth date, plus a time and place if you know them, and it calculates all three charts in a single step: Sun, Moon and rising signs, planetary aspects and elemental balance from the Western system; Nakshatra, Navamsa, planetary dignity and the Vimshottari Dasha timeline from the Vedic system; and the Four Pillars, Day Master and ten-year Luck Pillars from the Chinese system.

Most astrology tools give you one system's answer. Triad Astro gives you three, then helps you read the overlap - the themes that show up independently in all three are the ones worth a closer look.

Planetary positions are computed from ephemeris data aligned to NASA JPL standards, and birth places are resolved to coordinates with automatic timezone handling, so charts are accurate to the minute when the birth time is known. Ambiguous place names can be looked up first so you can confirm the right city.

No account or sign-in is required. Just ask for a reading - for example: "Calculate my tri-system birth chart. I was born March 14, 1990 at 7:45am in Bangalore, India."

payload.name: Medina Clean
payload.description: 预订 Rosa 的清洁服务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Medina Clean lets you book a house, apartment, condo, or small-business cleaning with Rosa Medina near Woodstock, Marietta, Kennesaw, Acworth, Canton, and Roswell, GA - right from your chat. Check whether your ZIP is in the service area, get an instant starting estimate, and send Rosa an appointment request. The assistant only sends a request: Rosa reviews the address, timing, and property and contacts you to confirm the final price and schedule - it never confirms a booking on its own. Bilingual (English/Spanish). No account or payment required.
payload.longDescription: Medina Clean 让你可以直接在聊天中，预订 Rosa Medina 在伍德斯托克、玛丽埃塔、肯尼索、阿克沃思、坎顿和佐治亚州罗斯韦尔附近提供的房屋、公寓、共管公寓或小型企业清洁服务。检查邮编是否在服务范围内，获取即时起始估价，并向 Rosa 发送预约请求。助手只会发送请求：Rosa 会审核地址、时间和房产，然后联系你确认最终价格和时间；它不会自行确认预订。支持英语和西班牙语。无需账户或付款。

payload.name: TNT Sapper
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TNT Sapper is a compact deduction puzzle played inside ChatGPT. Reveal safe tiles on an 8-by-8 field, use numbers to identify adjacent explosives, and flag suspected TNT. Clear all 54 safe tiles while avoiding 10 explosives to win. The first reveal and its surrounding tiles are protected. Play with touch, mouse, or keyboard, and start another field using New game in the component. Unfinished runs expire after 60 minutes. No separate player account, payment, or advertising is required.
payload.longDescription: TNT Sapper 是一款在 ChatGPT 中进行的简易推理益智游戏。在 8×8 方格中揭开安全格，根据数字判断相邻炸药的位置，并标记疑似 TNT。避开 10 个炸药，清除全部 54 个安全格即可获胜。首次揭开的格子及其周围格子受到保护。可使用触屏、鼠标或键盘游玩，并通过组件中的“新游戏”开始另一局。未完成的游戏会在 60 分钟后过期。无需单独的玩家账户，无需付款，也没有广告。

payload.name: Ziweave
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
You don't need to know how to read a birth chart to explore what it might mean for you. Ziweave introduces Zi Wei Dou Shu, a traditional Chinese astrology system, through readings based on your personal chart. Once you've finished setting up your birth details, Ziweave generates your chart and provides it to the AI, which uses the chart as the basis for its readings.

Ask about work, relationships or the themes of a month or year in your own words. Follow up with “Why?” or share what's happening in your life to explore how the reading relates to your situation. You bring the questions; the conversation helps make the chart easier to understand.

Try asking: “What does my chart suggest about my strengths at work, and how might I put them to use?”
